name: Ashley El Granvale
original_name: アシュリー・エル・グランベイル
source:
Age: 23 years old (13 at the time of Frederick's death)

Frederick's 5 years younger brother.
He's well versed in both literary and military arts, but he lacks self-confidence. His love for his brother is unwavering, and he admires Fred from the bottom of his heart. In other words, he's a huge brocon.
